premises.text: B2B shipping involves complex logistics with multiple transport providers
premises.evidence_span: if you switch to the industrial B2B world, things are much more complex. Imagine you are the head of operations for an automotive manufacturer. You need to ship spare parts from China to the U.S.

premises.text: Data in multimodal freight is highly fragmented and unreliable
premises.evidence_span: In the world of multimodal freight, data is highly fragmented. And this is a bad dream turned into a nightmare, because transport providers rely on legacy systems, producing unreliable information.

premises.text: Industrial shippers struggle to track goods and predict arrival times
premises.evidence_span: Industrial shippers struggle to answer two key questions, which are crucial for the bottom line. Where are the goods? And when will they arrive at the destination?

premises.text: Weikio provides real-time visibility on B2B transport flows
premises.evidence_span: Weikio is a SaaS platform bringing real-time visibility on B2B transport flows across sea, air, and road.

premises.text: Consolidation of transport providers improves data quality
premises.evidence_span: Our platform consolidates all transport providers, including shipping lines, airlines, and forwarders, using API and EDI connections.

premises.text: Using satellite data and IoT improves tracking accuracy
premises.evidence_span: We use satellite data to track ships and planes, and we connect to trucks' GPS and IoT devices.

premises.text: Data science can predict arrival times by considering external factors
premises.evidence_span: we use data science to predict times of arrival by taking into account external factors like real-time traffic or events

premises.text: Weikio can reduce safety inventories and save costs for shippers
premises.evidence_span: reliability, to reduce safety inventories and save up to several million euros a year.

premises.text: Weikio targets the multimodal overseas shipment market
premises.evidence_span: We focus on multimodal overseas shipments.

premises.text: Weikio has onboarded international companies with significant revenues
premises.evidence_span: we have already onboarded four international companies, which combine 45 billion euros of revenues.

value.text: Weikio improves supply chain efficiency and reduces costs for industrial shippers
value.evidence_span: We change the supply chain from reactive to predictive.
